question:
The given bar graph shows the data of the production of XYZ automobiles (in thousand numbers) by three branches, A, B and C of, a company over 5 years (2012-2016).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd7829011ebea8bd3e490d4a4ffb5fd1e6ca7c36c59b51559957ea4f7a26d51f.png] 

Which branch has recorded the highest percentage growth in production of XYZ automobiles in the given period?

options.text: Branch A with greater than 50% growth
Branch B with greater than 80% growth

solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd7829011ebea8bd3e490d4a4ffb5fd1e6ca7c36c59b51559957ea4f7a26d51f.png] 

**Concept Used:**

Basic Percentage Calculation

**Calculation:**

⇒ For the branch A, increase in production for the given period = 50 – 40 = 10

⇒ Percentage increase in branch A = (10)/(40)times 100 = 25%

⇒ For the branch B, increase in production for the given period = 55 – 30 = 25

⇒ Percentage increase in branch B = (25)/(30)times 100=(250)/(3) = 83.33%

⇒ For the branch C, increase in production for the given period = 60 – 50 = 10

⇒ Percentage increase in branch C = (10)/(50)times 100 = 20%

**Therefore, Branch B has highest recorded growth in the given period for more than 80%.**
